name: Kit
description_en:
Kit is an email-marketing service built around subscribers, broadcasts, forms and creator communication. Its paid Visual Automations organize the larger journey, while an Email Sequence supplies an ordered set of messages inside that journey. Tags and fields help determine entry and routing.

The current official Free guide allows a large broadcast audience but reserves Visual Automations and Email Sequences for paid plans. This distinction matters when evaluating a lead-magnet course or sales funnel: collecting addresses and sending one newsletter are different from running an automated sequence. This is documentation research, not a live product test.
description_zh:
Kit 是围绕订阅者、广播邮件、表单及创作者沟通的邮件营销服务。付费 Visual Automations 组织较大的沟通路径，Email Sequence 则在路径中提供有顺序的邮件；标签和字段帮助确定进入与分流。

当前官方 Free 指南允许较大的广播受众，但把可视化自动化和邮件序列留给付费套餐。评估引流课程或销售漏斗时，这一区别很重要：收集邮箱、发送一次简报和运行自动序列是不同任务。本文是文档研究，未实际测试产品。

core_features.explanation_en: Collect subscribers and send one-off email broadcasts; current Free includes unlimited forms, pages and broadcasts within its subscriber cap.
core_features.explanation_zh: 收集订阅者并发送单次广播；当前 Free 在人数上限内提供不限表单、页面和广播。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect entry points, actions, events and conditions into a subscriber journey.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把进入点、动作、事件和条件连接成订阅路径。

core_features.explanation_en: Enroll subscribers into a sequence and wait for its completion before continuing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 让订阅者进入邮件序列，并在完成后继续后续流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Pause accepts new subscribers but holds progress; Inactive blocks both entry and progress.
core_features.explanation_zh: 暂停仍接受新人但等待推进；Inactive 同时阻止进入和推进。

en: Collect photography-course signups and route them to a paid email sequence.
Create a truly independent automation version with separate underlying sequences.
zh: 收集摄影课程订阅并导向付费邮件序列。
用独立底层序列创建真正独立的自动化版本。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Define the form or tag entry and choose a plan with sequence support.
steps.zh: 定义表单或标签入口，并选择支持序列的套餐。

steps.en: Publish sequence emails and inspect schedule, exclusions and completion settings.
steps.zh: 发布序列邮件，并检查排程、排除与完成设置。

steps.en: Before editing, inspect waiting subscribers and shared sequence references.
steps.zh: 修改前检查等待订阅者及共享序列引用。

items.en: Automation copies share sequences until those sequences are separately duplicated and relinked.
items.zh: 自动化副本会共享序列，直到另行复制并重新关联序列。

items.en: Paused automations still allow new subscribers to enter.
items.zh: 暂停自动化仍允许新人进入。

sections.title_en: An automation and a sequence are different objects
sections.title_zh: 自动化与邮件序列是不同对象
sections.en:
Kit’s automation guide describes the larger flow: it can send sequences, assign tags and route subscribers. A sequence action enrolls someone in an ordered mailing series and normally waits for completion before the next action.

For an illustrative photography course, a form can start a journey, a tag can label the chosen topic and a sequence can deliver lessons. A later action might route the subscriber after completion. Design the learning series and the surrounding routing separately so a content change does not silently alter the intended journey.
sections.zh:
自动化指南描述较大的流程，可以发送序列、分配标签及分流。序列动作让订阅者进入有顺序的邮件系列，通常等完成后才执行下一动作。

例如摄影课程，表单启动路径、标签标记主题、序列发送课程，后续动作再在完成后分流。应分别设计课程内容与外层路由，避免改文案时无意改变预期路径。

sections.title_en: Applying a tag and waiting for a tag are not interchangeable
sections.title_zh: 添加标签与等待标签不能互换
sections.en:
The editing guide distinguishes an Action that changes a subscriber from an Event that waits for something to happen and a Condition that routes by a yes/no check. A Tag added Event is not the operation for applying a tag.

If the course should label a person as enrolled, use the applicable action. If it should wait for an external purchase signal, model that event and its source. A subscriber waiting at an event can be correct behavior rather than a failed send. Exact purchase integration behavior was not executed here.
sections.zh:
编辑指南区分改变订阅者的 Action、等待事情发生的 Event，以及按是／否路由的 Condition。Tag added Event 并不负责添加标签。

如果课程需要把某人标为已报名，应使用对应动作；如果等待外部购买信号，则需明确事件及来源。订阅者停在事件前可能正是正确行为，并不一定是发送失败。本文未执行具体购买集成。

sections.title_en: Pause keeps entry open; Inactive closes it
sections.title_zh: 暂停保留入口，Inactive 关闭入口
sections.en:
The status guide says new automations start Inactive, which blocks entry and holds existing subscribers before their next step. Paused automations still accept new subscribers, who wait after the entry point; existing subscribers also wait before progressing. Resuming releases that automation-level hold.

Before a course revision, decide whether new signups should accumulate. Inspect any linked Email Sequence separately rather than assuming the outer automation status establishes what every already enrolled sequence is doing. This profile does not test the state transition.
sections.zh:
状态指南说明新自动化从 Inactive 开始，该状态阻止进入，并让现有人在下一步前等待。Paused 仍接受新人，他们停在入口后，现有人也等待推进；恢复会解除自动化层面的等待。

修改课程前，应决定是否继续积累新订阅。还应单独检查关联 Email Sequence，不能只根据外层自动化状态推定每个已加入序列的行为。本文未测试状态切换。

sections.title_en: Duplicated automations can still share email content
sections.title_zh: 复制自动化仍可能共享邮件内容
sections.en:
The editing guide states that duplicating a Visual Automation reuses the same underlying Email Sequences. Editing a sequence in the copy therefore changes it in the original too. For an independent version, it instructs users to duplicate sequences and point the copied automation at the new ones.

For a course experiment, record both the routing copy and sequence identities. Removing an action does not undo tags or field changes already applied. Inspect subscribers waiting on a step before deleting it, because deletion can strand them and require manual recovery.
sections.zh:
编辑指南明确说明，复制 Visual Automation 会复用底层 Email Sequences，在副本中改序列也会改原版。需要独立版本时，应另复制序列，并让自动化副本指向新序列。

进行课程实验时，应同时记录路由副本和序列身份。删除动作也不会撤销已经添加的标签或字段修改。删除步骤前应检查等待中的订阅者，因为删除可能使其停滞并需要手动恢复。

sections.title_en: A published automation is not enough to make every email send
sections.title_zh: 自动化已发布不代表每封邮件都会发送
sections.en:
The sequence troubleshooting guide separately checks enrollment, email publication, sender address, first-send delay, schedule days and exclusions. A published sequence email can still wait for its schedule, and a completed subscriber does not automatically receive later-added emails.

For a missing lesson, inspect the actual subscriber and next unread email before bulk re-enrollment. The waiting guide also says builder counts can be cached, while the subscriber-list view behind the count is not. A stale number should be investigated before making a duplicate send attempt.
sections.zh:
序列排错指南分别检查加入状态、邮件发布、发件地址、首封延迟、发送日和排除条件。已发布邮件仍可能等待排程，已完成的人也不会自动收到后来追加的邮件。

课程缺失时，应先查看具体订阅者和下一封未读邮件，再考虑批量重新加入。等待指南还说明画布计数可能有缓存，点击后查看的订阅者列表则无缓存。应先调查陈旧数字，避免重复发送。

sections.title_en: The current Free plan is for broadcasts, not paid automation
sections.title_zh: 当前 Free 主要提供广播而非付费自动化
sections.en:
The current Free guide gives up to 10,000 subscribers, unlimited forms/landing pages and unlimited broadcasts. Visual Automations, Email Sequences, Rules and RSS campaigns require a paid tier. The guide says existing paid automations and sequences stop running on Free and remain stored for later upgrade.

Recommendations are enabled at signup but may be turned off without changing the plan. They are not evidence of guaranteed subscriber growth or income. Check the current account offer instead of carrying forward older descriptions of free automation entitlements.
sections.zh:
当前 Free 指南提供最多 10,000 位订阅者、不限表单／落地页及广播。Visual Automations、Email Sequences、Rules 和 RSS 活动需要付费；已有付费自动化及序列降到 Free 后停止运行，但保留以供以后升级使用。

注册时启用推荐，也可关闭而不改变套餐。推荐功能不能证明保证增长或收入。应核对当前账户方案，不沿用旧免费自动化权限说明。

sections.title_en: Separate a first-year promotion from recurring cost
sections.title_zh: 区分首年优惠与持续成本
sections.en:
The 1,000-subscriber view renders Creator at $33/month with $390 billed yearly. The Pro card includes a limited first-year discount and a different standard renewal rate. Rounded monthly equivalents and a promotional annual charge are not a universal month-to-month quote.

Kit is worth evaluating for creator newsletters and paid course journeys maintained through tags, forms and sequences. The pricing page uses Pro while help articles still say Creator Pro; confirm that the account’s features match the intended tier. No commerce purchase, AI connector, SMS availability or self-hosting entitlement was verified.
sections.zh:
1,000 位订阅者页面呈现 Creator 月均 $33、按年收取 $390；Pro 卡片包含限时首年优惠，续费标准价格不同。四舍五入的月均数及优惠年费不能当作通用月付报价。

需要以标签、表单和序列维护创作者简报及付费课程路径时，可评估 Kit。价格页称 Pro，帮助文章仍用 Creator Pro，需确认账户功能与目标档位对应。本文未验证电商购买、AI 连接器、短信可用地区或自托管权利。

research_gaps.en: The edit guide says changing sequence retention is not retroactive, while the waiting guide suggests progress after changing it. Existing on-hold subscriber recovery needs support confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 编辑指南称修改序列保留设置不追溯，等待指南却建议修改后可继续；已有 on-hold 订阅者的恢复需支持确认。

research_gaps.en: Current pricing uses Pro while help uses Creator Pro. Exact renewal/checkout, transaction fees, UI languages, region, source license and data location remain unverified; no live account or sending test was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 当前价格称 Pro，帮助称 Creator Pro；确切续费／结算、交易费、界面语言、地区、源码许可及数据位置仍未核实，未执行账户或发送测试。
